suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as treatment exposure associated malignancy. Require documented heart transplantation, chronic post-transplant immunosuppressive exposure, and a separately histologically diagnosed skin malignancy arising after transplantation. PMID 41322122 provides particularly strong evidence for CNI + azathioprine exposure and SCC risk; do not treat all immunosuppressive regimens as equivalent or infer that transplant status alone establishes individual causation. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.

suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-8 adds this relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. Chronic kidney disease is a recognized post-heart-transplant complication, with calcineurin-inhibitor nephrotoxicity acting within a multifactorial post-transplant risk model. Require an actual heart transplant and separately established post-transplant chronic kidney disease with compatible chronology. Do not infer CKD from transplant status alone. Preserve preexisting CKD, diabetes, hypertension, perioperative acute kidney injury, cardiorenal/hemodynamic factors, rejection-related injury, and other nephrotoxic exposures. The cited literature supports only this constrained relationship and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
